class: A backend redirect to a frontend page written as a bare path ('/broker/connected') resolves against the host the request came in on; when a third party (an OAuth provider) calls the API's own host directly, the browser lands on the API, which serves no pages, so every success and refusal shows a 404 - and tests that assert the bare Location string, or open the page directly, confirm the bug instead of catching it.
mechanism: Kite calls back on KITE_REDIRECT_URL = http://127.0.0.1:8765/kite/callback (the API); broker.py:196 and :262 redirected to bare paths; the API has no static/page fallback and the vite proxy forwards only /api and /ws; tests_app/test_kite_login.py:127 asserted the bare path and the Playwright tests used page.goto on the frontend directly.

first_seen.where: W-058 live owner-login proof; again 2026-10-16 15:34 IST (session-handover-2026-10-16.md), a week after PR 162 added the pages
first_seen.evidence: the backend's USER_INPUT_003 404 body after a good login (issue 159); GC-1 Tier A review 2026-10-16 traced the origin

fix: Redirect to an absolute, start-up-validated FRONTEND_ORIGIN (scheme + host + port only) plus the page path; the class test resolves every Location against the real callback URL with urljoin, as a browser does, and asserts the frontend origin for success and every refusal code (W-088).

detection.note: Becomes guarded when W-088's class test (urljoin of each Location against KITE_REDIRECT_URL, every REFUSAL_CODES member) merges; the live check is the next owner login (GC-3).

occurrences.evidence: 404 again after PR 162 had added the landing pages
